title: Service-Fee Part of a Grocery Order Photo-Review Claim
content:
# Service-fee part of a grocery order photo-review claim

A finance note for Cartwise Grocery Orders on the service-fee part a photo-review claim carries. It reads the order's service fee entries and whether a Cartwise+ Membership was recorded on the order at checkout.

**Clause.** The photo-review fee part is added to the line value. When the order carries a waiver from the member service-fee rate and a Cartwise+ plan is recorded on the order, the fee part is the line value times the standing service-fee rate, that is the service fee billed less the service fee already returned, divided by the item subtotal less every item refund standing on the order. When the order carries no such waiver but a service fee is billed, the fee part is the line value times the service fee billed divided by the item subtotal. Otherwise there is no fee part. The fee part is rounded to the cent.

The item subtotal is the sum of the order's billed item lines. "Every item refund standing on the order" counts all item refund entries on the order, whatever their reason. The service fee already returned is the sum of the fee refunds standing against the order's service fee.

## Branches

| Member service-fee rate waiver on the order | Cartwise+ plan recorded | Service fee billed | Fee part |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | — | Line value times (fee billed less fee returned) over (item subtotal less item refunds) |
| No | — | Yes | Line value times fee billed over item subtotal |
| No | — | No | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

*Member order.* Line value 13.25. Service fee billed 4.20, of which 0.35 has been returned; item subtotal 90.00 with 20.00 of item refunds standing. The standing service-fee rate is 3.85 divided by 70.00, that is 0.055. The fee part is 13.25 times 0.055, 0.72875, rounded to 0.73.

*Order without the member waiver.* Line value 13.25; service fee billed 6.00; item subtotal 80.00. The fee part is 13.25 times 6.00 divided by 80.00, 0.99375, rounded to 0.99.

*No service fee billed and no waiver.* No fee part.
